name: APT36 Persistence 1 - WMI Permanent Event Subscription (T1546.003)
blast_radius: Gated by BAS_CONFIRM_APT36_WMI_SUBSCRIPTION=true (exact) and administrator only. Creates a run-tagged filter, consumer and binding whose filter never fires, reads them back, then removes all three and verifies none remain.
detection: EDR: new permanent WMI subscription with a command-line consumer
cleanup:
Get-ChildItem -Path $env:TEMP -Filter 'bas_a36_*' -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Remove-Item -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
$ns = 'root\subscription'
Get-CimInstance -Namespace $ns -ClassName __FilterToConsumerBinding -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.Filter.Name -like 'bas_a36_*' } | Remove-CimInstance -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
Get-CimInstance -Namespace $ns -ClassName CommandLineEventConsumer -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.Name -like 'bas_a36_*' } | Remove-CimInstance -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
Get-CimInstance -Namespace $ns -ClassName __EventFilter -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.Name -like 'bas_a36_*' } | Remove-CimInstance -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue

name: APT36 Persistence 2 - Startup Folder Script (T1547.001)
blast_radius: Writes a run-tagged .cmd into the per-user Startup folder, then removes it and verifies removal. Never run at logon.
telemetry: Sysmon EID 11: file created in the Startup folder
detection: EDR: new script in the Startup folder
cleanup:
Get-ChildItem -Path $env:TEMP -Filter 'bas_a36_*' -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Remove-Item -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
Get-ChildItem -Path (Join-Path $env:APPDATA 'Microsoft\Windows\Start Menu\Programs\Startup') -Filter 'bas_a36_*' -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Remove-Item -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue

name: APT36 Persistence 3 - Service Create/Start/Stop/Delete (T1543.003)
blast_radius: Gated by BAS_CONFIRM_APT36_SERVICE_CREATE=true (exact) and administrator only. Creates a run-tagged service, starts and stops it, then deletes it and verifies removal with Get-Service. Only its own test service is touched.
detection: EDR: new service created and started by a script host
cleanup:
Get-ChildItem -Path $env:TEMP -Filter 'bas_a36_*' -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Remove-Item -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
Get-Service -Name 'bas_a36_*' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | ForEach-Object { try { Stop-Service -Name $_.Name -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue } catch {}; & (Join-Path $env:SystemRoot 'System32\sc.exe') delete $_.Name | Out-Null }

name: APT36 Evasion 1 - Per-User COM CLSID Override (T1546.015)
blast_radius: Writes a run-tagged CLSID under HKCU Software Classes with an InprocServer32 override, reads it back, then removes the whole key and verifies removal. No existing CLSID is touched.
telemetry: Sysmon EID 13 and 14: registry value set and key deleted
detection: EDR: new per-user CLSID with an InprocServer32 override
cleanup:
Get-ChildItem -Path $env:TEMP -Filter 'bas_a36_*' -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Remove-Item -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
Get-ChildItem 'HKCU:\SOFTWARE\Classes\CLSID' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.PSChildName -match '^\{[0-9a-fA-F-]+\}$' } | ForEach-Object { try { if ((Get-ItemProperty (Join-Path $_.PSPath 'InprocServer32') -Name '(default)' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue).'(default)' -like '*bas_a36_*') { Remove-Item $_.PSPath -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue } } catch {} }

name: APT36 Evasion 2 - Defender Exclusion Add/Verify/Remove (T1562.001)
blast_radius: Gated by BAS_CONFIRM_APT36_DEFENDER_EXCLUSION=true (exact) and administrator only, because it changes live AV configuration. Adds an exclusion for a run-tagged temp path, verifies the exclusion took effect from live Get-MpPreference state (not the command exit code), then removes it and re-verifies. Refuses to run if the path is somehow already excluded.
telemetry: Sysmon EID 13: Defender exclusion registry value changed
detection: SIEM: new Defender path exclusion added outside a change window
